name: cytotoxic T-lymphocyte associated protein 4

function.text: CTLA4 encodes cytotoxic T-lymphocyte protein 4. Annotated molecular activities include receptor decoy activity. It participates in immune response and DNA damage response.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome due to CTLA4 haploinsufficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
